title: 260. Next Permutation

examples.explanation: Among orderings above [1,2,3], [1,3,2] is the smallest.
[3,2,1] is the largest ordering, so wrap to the smallest.
With duplicates included, [1,5,1] is the next larger ordering.

hints: Scan from the right for the first position that is smaller than its successor (the pivot); everything right of it is descending.
Swap the pivot with the smallest element to its right that is larger than it, then reverse the suffix into ascending order.
